panel_installation_area: Take it in daylight, without the sun directly in front of the camera.

earthing: Show the earthing pit or the earth connection up close.

Hold the phone steady so the photo is not blurred.

completion_overview: Step back and show the whole installation in one photo.

default: Take it in daylight or with good light.
Hold the phone steady and tap the screen to focus.
Fit the whole subject in the frame.
